raw_segments.text: I am aware that down to the present time, the fish-styled lamatins and dugongs, pigfish
and sowfish of the coffins of Nantucket, are included by many naturalists among the whales.
But as these pigfish are a noisy, contemptible set, mostly lurking in the mouths of rivers
and feeding on wet hay, and especially as they do not spout, I deny their credentials
as whales, and have presented them with their passports to quit the kingdom of setology.
